def test_return_precision_two_vs_three_decimals():

    # Input chosen yields ternary fraction after operations:
    # weight=5.1 => base = 7.5 + 0.1*1.2 = 7.5 + 0.12 = 7.62

    # Use different input: weight=5.01 => base = 7.5 + 0.01*1.2 = 7.5 + 0.012 = 7.512
    # Rounding to two decimals -> 7.51 ; to three decimals -> 7.512.

    base_expected_two = round(7.5 + (wt - 5) * 1.2, 2)
    base_expected_three = round(7.5 + (wt - 5) * 1.2, 3)
    assert base_expected_two != base_expected_three  # sanity check difference exists
    actual_two = shipping_cost(wt)

        f"if {actual_two} == {base_expected_three} then rounding likely uses three decimals."

    # Express path multiplies then rounds again; maintain same logic
    exp_two = shipping_cost(wt, express=True)
    assert exp_two == round(base_expected_two * 2, 2)
